phases.title: Build shell, C++ ownership, and JNI on Java-originated threads
phases.milestone: The deleted module builds again. Kotlin creates one native object, receives test callbacks on the calling Java thread, and destroys the object without leaking either side of JNI.

phases.title: Image-processing foundations before any decoder or GPU API
phases.milestone: Pixels, RGBA bytes, stride, rectangles, resampling, encoded files, and container signatures are understood and tested as independent data transformations.

phases.title: Native threads, the Android surface, EGL, OpenGL ES, and one generated frame
phases.milestone: A render-on-demand native thread owns EGL and OpenGL ES, copy-uploads known RGBA bytes, presents them in the real `TiledImageView`, and reports readiness from the render thread.

phases.title: Image coordinate systems, EXIF, fit, pyramids, tiles, and render geometry
phases.milestone: Pure functions transform real viewport bounds into logical-image bounds, pyramid levels, tile addresses, decoder requests, and GPU quads without mixing coordinate spaces.

phases.title: Kotlin file preparation and two interchangeable decoder backends
phases.milestone: Kotlin prepares one file safely. C++ selects an NDK or Java backend and produces a logically oriented, stride-correct rectangular RGBA result.

phases.title: Single-document tiled rendering, scheduling, refinement, and bounded memory
phases.milestone: One document gains complete first coverage, visible fine tiles, ancestor fallback, crossfade, pooled textures, bounded cache, stale-work rejection, and deterministic idle/shutdown behavior.

phases.title: Direct Kotlin transforms, gestures, paging, lifecycle, and errors
phases.milestone: The Kotlin controller drives pan, fling, pinch, quick scale, double tap, a three-document filmstrip, pager settling, saved state, surface recreation, memory pressure, and explicit errors.

phases.title: Prediction, measurement, optional zero-copy, and format boundaries
phases.milestone: Optimization is measured after correctness. The copy path remains canonical; hardware-buffer import is capability-gated and retained only when end-to-end traces justify it.

phases.title: Independent integration and reference comparison
phases.milestone: The learner-authored engine passes correctness, lifecycle, stress, and performance gates before the sealed reference implementation is opened for comparison.
